summary: # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial: How to Make a Bunny Girl Outfit from a T-Shirt (Part 3) ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will transform a standard dress into a bunny girl outfit based on the neckline of the original dress. We will cover the steps involved in modifying the dress, including the production process of stockings. ## Step 1: Setting Up the 3D Drawing Tool First, we find the **3D Drawing Tool**, which can be accessed via the **3D Panel Tool**. We will follow the sketch of the virtual model's chest. ### Creating the Outline 1. Switch to a semi-transparent surface. 2. Draw a curve along the middle. - Start from the center. - Press the **CTRL** key to create a curve point. - Move to the side of the **Shen Dao** position. - Double-click to finish the curve. ### Adjusting the Curve To make cutting easier, connect directly to the Shen Dao point. If the virtual model’s material is unclear, switch to a black and white surface to enhance visibility. ## Step 2: Cutting the 3D Lines Since the edge spans from one panel line to another, we can use the tool to cut along this 3D line. As it has a symmetrical relationship, we select the cut below the symmetrical column to ensure an automatic symmetrical cut. We will then delete the excess panels. ### Modifying the Back Panel For the back panel, pull a horizontal line from the bottom of the page: 1. Move the Shen Dao point down slightly to avoid affecting the cut line. 2. Simulate the application change. 3. Use the **Internal Multilinear Line Tool** starting from the bottom of the page. Double-click to finish the line. 4. Go to the middle of the back panel line, and double-click to finish. ## Step 3: Editing the Panels Using the **Edit Panel Tool**, select the internal line, right-click to select cut, and delete the excess part. If the top panel has no constraints, it might affect the overall volume. Hence, we need to adjust it. ### Adjusting Panel Tightness 1. Move the side point inward a little to tighten it. 2. Check the front panel; if it appears loose, we need to modify it. 3. Raise the front panel in the state of opening simulation to ensure better fitting with the virtual model. ## Step 4: Creating a Seam Line To create a smooth and continuous seam line: 1. Turn the line to a vertical direction for a whole cut line. 2. Use the **Internal Multilinear Line Tool** from the cut point on the chest, going up vertically. Press **Shift** to double-click and finish creating a vertical line. 3. Select the cut seam line to preserve it. ### Merging Panels Separate the small triangle panel and merge the ends of the previous seam line. Move one point to the other near the line point, converting one to a curve point. ## Step 5: Final Adjustments Observe the chest fitting; if not well attached, adjust the width of the groove by making a cut in between. Press the **CTRL** key to move a small section along the curve for a better fit. ### Manually Adjusting the Model After opening the model, manually drag the board to ensure the fabric hangs correctly on the virtual model. Check from the side view; adjust the curve if it does not relate well. ## Step 6: Refining the Corners 1. Use the **Editor Tool** to drag the curve, making the corner near 90 degrees. 2. Adjust the back by moving the back point up slightly for a flatter appearance. 3. Connect the front and back curves to create a uniform look. ## Step 7: Sewing the Panels Use the **Line Sewing Tool** to sew the two sides together. If there are creases along the sewing line, separate the two lines slightly and reopen the simulation. ### Smoothing the Transition Drag the straight lines to create a smooth transition. Adjust the lower points for further smoothing in the 3D window. ## Step 8: Repairing Wrinkles To address wrinkles on both sides of the line: 1. Pull the point at the bottom of the line down to make it longer. 2. Adjust the cut to tighten the waist, ensuring both sides are adjusted equally. ## Step 9: Completing the Bunny Girl Pants To create the pants for the bunny girl: 1. Find the **3D Panel Tool** and draw the cut line on the panel. 2. Open the transparency chart by pressing **Alt+4** and draw according to the model’s body curve. 3. After drawing, press **Alt+1** to return to normal display. ### Finalizing Cuts and Sewing Switch to the **Edit Dot Tool** to cut the excess panels. Open the simulation and use the **Line Sewing Tool** to sew the front and back together. Adjust the lengths as needed. ## Conclusion This concludes the tutorial on transforming a dress into a bunny girl outfit using Marvelous Designer. By following these detailed steps, you can create a well-fitted and stylish outfit complete with pants.
